```{r}
#| label: shared-setup
#| include: false

# Shared setup for every R blog post, pulled in with
#   {{< include ../_setup.qmd >}}
# Posts that need different settings (e.g. options(digits = 2)) override them
# in their own chunk after the include.

# Eager cache loading. Several posts cache multi-million-row frames, which
# the default lazy loading chokes on.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache.lazy = FALSE)
options(digits = 4)

# Match the site's typography. These names must resolve to the *static* TTF
# builds: under ragg the variable-font builds ignore their weight axis, so
# "light" and "heavy" would render identically.
systemfonts::require_font("Commissioner", verbose = FALSE)
systemfonts::register_variant(
  "Commissioner Light",
  family = "Commissioner", weight = "light"
)
systemfonts::register_variant(
  "Fraunces Soft Light",
  family = "Fraunces 72pt Soft", weight = "light"
)

# brand.yml::theme_brand_ggplot2() applies the palette from _brand.yml but
# handles colors only, so the fonts are layered on here.
brand_theme <- function(base_size = 16) {
  brand.yml::theme_brand_ggplot2(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "Commissioner Light"),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(family = "Fraunces Soft Light"),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(family = "Fraunces Soft Light")
    )
}
```
